page_title: INT 1-0 ROM | Inter v AS Roma 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Fabio Maresca has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
90+2' A cross into the box from Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is cleared.
90+1' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Davide Frattesi (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.
90' It should have been a goal! Carlos Augusto (Inter) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
89' Substitution. Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) in, Leandro Paredes out.
88' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
86' Inter take a short corner kick.
86' Matteo Darmian (Inter) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Denzel Dumfries departs the field of play to be replaced by Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
84' Here is a change. Edoardo Bove is going off and Salvatore Foti gives the last tactical orders to Andrea Belotti (AS Roma).
84' Salvatore Foti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) replacing Stephan El Shaarawy.
84' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Carlos Augusto (Inter) is replacing Federico Dimarco.

81' 1 - 0 Goal! Federico Dimarco displays great vision and sends a pass to Marcus Thuram (Inter), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 1:0.

79' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball has crossed the sideline. Inter are taking a throw-in.
78' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
78' Inter take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
77' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma). Fabio Maresca saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Inter have a free kick.
76' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post.
75' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Hakan Calhanoglu will be replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
75' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Henrikh Mkhitaryan is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
75' It's time for a substitution. Zeki Celik (AS Roma) comes on in place of Nicola Zalewski.
71' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to find Denzel Dumfries, but he puts too much power on the pass.
69' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle as Denzel Dumfries (Inter) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
68' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
67' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
67' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Inter.

67' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom left corner. Yann Sommer shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
66' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.

64' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) was quite harsh and Fabio Maresca didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. AS Roma have a free kick from a promising distance.
63' Marcus Thuram (Inter) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
62' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

59' This was a piece of cake for Rui Patricio. Lautaro Martinez (Inter) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
56' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
55' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul after Denzel Dumfries (Inter) hacks down one of his opponents.
54' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in a cross from the corner, but Rui Patricio reads it well and gathers the ball.
53' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The linesman makes the right call and Inter will have a corner.
51' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
50' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
48' Marcus Thuram (Inter) connects well with the free kick, but heads the ball just over the bar from close in.
47' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Fabio Maresca had an easy-decision to make.
46' Simone Inzaghi makes a switch. Matteo Darmian is coming on in place of Benjamin Pavard (Inter) at the start of the second period.
46' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The ball rebounds to Nicolo Barella (Inter) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
44' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Inter hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
39' That's unlucky! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
37' A sweet pass inside the box gives Benjamin Pavard (Inter) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
37' 69:31 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
35' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle after Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
33' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Benjamin Pavard (Inter) for his blatant foul.
31' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
30' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Fabio Maresca signals. Inter are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
28' The ball rebounds to Benjamin Pavard (Inter) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the right post.
26' Marcus Thuram (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
23' A rebound falls at the feet of Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
23' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
19' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

19' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
15' Marcus Thuram (Inter) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom left corner. His promising effort is kept out by Rui Patricio, who pulls off a stunning save!
15' The attendance is 75573.
14' A quickly taken corner by Inter.
14' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
13' Marcus Thuram (Inter) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Now Inter have a corner.
12' Poor challenge! Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is penalised for tripping and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle.
11' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
10' Inter win a corner.
10' Marcus Thuram (Inter) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
10' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
7' Marcus Thuram (Inter) commits a foul and Fabio Maresca immediately signals a free kick.
6' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
5' A crossfield pass from Benjamin Pavard (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates.
